name: boavizta/boaviztapi-php
description: PHP client for BoaviztAPI, the environmental footprint API for digital hardware

suggest.psr/http-client-implementation: Any PSR-18 HTTP client (e.g. guzzlehttp/guzzle, symfony/http-client, php-http/curl-client)
suggest.psr/http-factory-implementation: Any PSR-17 factories (e.g. nyholm/psr7, guzzlehttp/psr7, laminas/laminas-diactoros)
suggest.psr/cache-implementation: Any PSR-6 cache pool, to cache GET responses (reference data, archetypes)
suggest.psr/log-implementation: Any PSR-3 logger, to log HTTP calls and errors

scripts-descriptions.test:live: Replays the contract scenarios against a real BoaviztAPI (BOAVIZTA_API_URL, default api.boavizta.org)
scripts-descriptions.record-fixtures: Records the contract fixtures from a real BoaviztAPI
scripts-descriptions.verify-live: Runs the live tests and, if they pass, updates tests/Live/last-verified.json
